result.title: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry
result.summary: Precise control over camera and object motion is essential for professional video production. Existing methods control objects only coarsely, through image-plane cues that are ambiguous in depth and rotation or through 3D tracks and blobs that lack complete geometry and lose consistency across viewpoint changes. We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame. This representation provides an intuitive 3D control interface and prevents unobserved geometry from being regenerated independently in every frame. We render the controlled scene as a depth video and introduce a Motion Adapter that transforms this geometric scaffold into video while synthesizing view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics. For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline. We further introduce Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU), which jointly evaluates adherence to prescribed object motion and preservation of object identity. Experiments demonstrate that 4Director consistently outperforms prior methods in visual quality and in camera and object control.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 4Director，用每帧一个刚体变换的显式 4D 场景表示（每个物体重建成规范网格）来条件化视频世界模型，并通过 Motion Adapter 将深度视频几何脚手架转成外观一致、含非刚体动态的视频，同时给出带刚体场景标注的数据集与评估指标 IG-IoU。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于视频世界模型与生成方向，但与 VLM/LVR 推理主线联系间接；可供核查的线索是显式几何状态（规范网格＋逐帧刚体变换）如何作为结构化条件控制生成，或可类比 LVR 中保持实体关系与几何一致性的内部状态表示与干预方式。
